1. 고레스 칙령\n - 예전에 애굽에서 탈출하던 기록을 출애굽기라고 했:
1. The Decree of Cyrus
 - The record of the escape from Egypt long ago was called Exodus, and Ezra and Nehemiah, you could call them the 'Exodus from Babylon' — after Babylon falls, the people are set free from Babylon and come back to Jerusalem.
<스1:1~4> 바사 왕 고레스 원년에 여호와께서 예레미야의 입으로 하신:
<Ezra 1:1~4> Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying, Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem. And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.
 - This is the so-called Decree of Cyrus. It's exactly the same as 2 Chronicles 36:22 and following. So close that if they were scrolls, you could just glue one onto the end of the other. Because it's identical, not a single word different, people think Ezra must have written Chronicles.
<대하36:22~23> 바사 왕 고레스 원년에 여호와께서 예레미야의 입으:
<2 Chr 36:22~23> Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying, Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? The LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.
 - We're studying the Bible like this, arranged in chronological order — how is it? Does the Bible start to come into view a bit?
포로 귀환의 과정: The Process of the Return from Exile
2. 포로 귀환의 과정\n 1) 제 1차 귀환(B.C 536년) - 스룹:
2. The Process of the Return from Exile
 1) First Return (B.C 536) - led by Zerubbabel
 2) Second Return (B.C 457) - led by Ezra
 3) Third Return (B.C 444) - led by Nehemiah
 - The leaders of the first Return were the governor called Sheshbazzar, or Zerubbabel, and the high priest Joshua.
고레스 칙령이 B.C 538년에 났지만 칙령이 났다고 해서 바로 올 수: The Decree of Cyrus came out in B.C 538, but just because a decree came out doesn't mean they could come right away.
거기서 살던 삶이 있고 생활이 있고, 모집도 해야 하고 홍보도 해야 하고: They had lives there, a whole way of living, and people had to be recruited, the word had to be spread.
이렇게 준비가 한 1년 걸리고 4~5개월 걸려서 왔더니 B.C 536년에:
So the preparation took about a year, the trip took 4~5 months, and they arrived in B.C 536.
 - That is exactly 70 years after the first Exile in B.C 606, when King Jehoiakim and Daniel and others were taken away.
<스3:8> 예루살렘 하나님의 전에 이른 지 이 년 이 월에 스알디엘의:
<Ezra 3:8> Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.
 - When they got back, they first had to build places to live, so about a year went by, and after one full year and two months they held the groundbreaking ceremony for the temple.
At this point, people who had been taken captive at about 10 years old came back at 80. These were people who had seen Solomon's temple burn before they were taken.
<시126:1> 여호와께서 시온의 포로를 돌리실 때에 우리가 꿈꾸는 것:
<Ps 126:1> When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream. Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing.
 - They were overwhelmed with emotion: "We wondered if we'd ever live to see Jerusalem again, and now He's letting us rebuild the ruined temple with our own hands!"
<스3:12~13> 제사장들과 레위 사람들과 족장들 중에 여러 노인은 첫:
<Ezra 3:12~13> But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
 - So the work goes on with all this emotion, but the problem was the people who had been living on that land for 70 years.
생각해 보세요. 70년 동안 내 땅이다 하고 살았는데 갑자기 나가라고 하: Think about it. You've lived there for 70 years thinking it's your land, and suddenly you're told to get out — you'd be stunned, right?
그 주변 떨거지들이 와서 훼방하고 불법 공사다 하고 막 투서를 넣고, 페:
The riffraff from around there came and interfered, filed complaints saying it was illegal construction, bribed Persian officials, filed group petitions, and got the work stopped.
 - Even when something is God's will, there can be plenty of opposition. In fact, the more something is God's will, the more the devil opposes it. When you're doing something and hard times come, don't say, "Oh, I guess this isn't God's will." Say, "Oh, this must really be God's will — look how the devil is getting in the way."
이 성경 캠프는 아무도 반대를 안 했는데 큰일이야 정말....\n - 결:
Nobody opposed this Bible camp at all, so we're really in trouble....
 - In the end an official order came down from Persia, and the work was halted for 15 years, until the second year of Darius king of Persia.
이 때 어떤 선지자가 나타난다면 무슨 말을 했을까요?: If a prophet showed up at this time, what would he have said?
Okay, let's go meet Haggai, the prophet who was active at this time.
